plugins.name: ActivoBank
plugins.description: Parses ActivoBank Portugal PDF account statements with positioned column detection, statement-level year inference, and running balance extraction.

versions.changelog:
- Initial standalone Plugin SDK v1 release migrated from Personal Ledger's `PdfParserActivobankService`.
- Supports positioned multi-page PDF column extraction, `A TRANSPORTAR` page breaks, `SALDO FINAL` footer stops, and `EXT. N. YYYY/NNN` statement-level year inference with December-on-January rollover.
- Emits canonical ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` dates, normalized `.`-decimal amounts and running balances (including `0.00`), raw PDF evidence (`rawDate`, `rawAmount`, `runningBalance`, `yearInferred`), and row diagnostics.

plugins.name: BankInter
plugins.description: Parses BankInter Portugal PDF account statements with positioned column detection, running balance extraction, currency detection, and exchange-fee fallback.

versions.changelog:
- Initial standalone Plugin SDK v1 release migrated from Personal Ledger's `PdfParserBankinterService`.
- Supports positioned multi-page PDF column extraction, `A TRANSPORTAR` page breaks, `Conforme` footer stops, `Moeda` ISO currency extraction, and `Taxa Câmbio` exchange-fee fallback.
- Emits canonical ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` dates, normalized `.`-decimal amounts and running balances (including `0.00`), raw PDF evidence (`rawDate`, `rawAmount`, `runningBalance`), and row diagnostics.
